Create ONE square SEAMLESS TILEABLE WOODEN SHIP-CABIN FLOOR TEXTURE, 1024x1024 target, full-bleed completely OPAQUE image, for repeating UVs in both X and Y. This explicitly uses the seamless surface output mode, NOT the six-object transparent atlas mode. No objects, characters, surrounding border, framing outline, transparent gutters or isolated tile.
AUTHORITATIVE STYLE B: preserve the ORIGINAL sample atlases' concise geometric shape language, screen-axis aligned construction, restrained palette/saturation, planar low-contrast shading and compact low-resolution 2D raster detail density. Mild antialiasing, not razor-sharp vector and not hard stair-step pixel art. Surface refinement strictly inside material: soft sparse woodgrain and tiny warm timber color variations only. No painterly brushwork, photoreal micrograin, noisy scratches, weathering, dark knots, glossy plastic volume or dramatic lighting.
FLOOR CONTENT: warm medium honey-brown timber planks laid horizontally, equal-width parallel rows, staggered simple board end joints, fine consistent dark-brown single join lines. Clear simple timber material, no nails, metal fixtures, rugs or ornament. Absolutely orthographic TOP VIEW: no side faces, bevel height, thickness or perspective. No outside perimeter stroke. All planks lie flat on one continuous plane.
CRITICAL TOROIDAL EDGE LOCK: Think of this image as one period of an infinitely repeating continuous floor. LEFT border continues exactly into RIGHT border, TOP border continues exactly into BOTTOM border. Plank-row spacing and joint-line thickness/positions must wrap in both axes. Any grain or seam that crosses one edge must resume at the corresponding opposite edge at exactly the matching location, width, direction and color. Board-end joints should form a coherent staggered repeating schedule across the wrap, not a special boundary line. Never add a frame or whole-tile outline. Opposite edge RGB must match without an abrupt brightness/chroma jump. Design matching edge neighborhoods as well as matching edge pixels so filtering across tile boundaries remains natural. All four corners meet seamlessly when four copies touch.
UNIFORM LIGHT AND COLOR: diffuse nondirectional ambient light, spatially uniform average honey-brown tone across the ENTIRE tile. No vignette, no bright center/dark border, no top-to-bottom or left-to-right lighting gradient, no hotspots, cast shadows, ambient occlusion along outer edges, stains or local dark/light patches that reveal a repeated square. Fine material variation must not create broad blocks or stripes at tile boundaries.
OUTPUT ONLY THE SINGLE ORIGINAL TILE, not a tiled-preview image, not a 3x3 grid or collage, no text, labels, watermark, background margin or drop shadow. validation.method: Original PNG bytes retained. Unity Texture2D.wrapMode=Repeat and Graphics.Blit UV scale(3,3) to offscreen RenderTexture; no Scene modification and no generated image used as generation input.
validation.interpretation: Large rectangular tonal boundaries substantially reduced in inspected 3x3 preview. Opposite edge pixels are NOT identical. These mean differences alone neither prove nor disprove perceptual seamlessness. Exact edge continuity/fully invisible seams is NOT certified.
validation.pipeline_changes: No new skills/models/postprocessing. No pixel editing or crop of final PNG; only preview rendering.
validation.application: No project texture importer or cabin prefab replaced in this generation task. Existing applied floor remains until texture review.
